summary: Iteration 26 (perf fixes for products/investments payload + deposit outbound_ip) fully passes. Backend 16/16 pytest cases green. /api/products payload dropped to ~1.4 KB (< 5 KB budget) with image_url rewritten to /api/products/{id}/image?v=<hash>. /api/products?full=true (admin) still returns raw base64 data URIs. /api/products/{id}/image serves proper image/jpeg with body >500B, unauthenticated, and returns 404 for unknown ids. /api/investments returns product_image_url as rewritten URL (no data:). Admin PUT guard: sending the served URL as image_url does NOT overwrite the stored base64 (verified via ?full=true roundtrip). POST /api/deposits with each of paynow/shpay/onesspay/juntbest returns in ~1.1s (well under 3s) with outbound_ip == 46.20.101.18 (never 'unknown'). Regression: /health, /settings/public, /coupons/daily, /coupons/history, /referrals/rewards, /admin/deposits, /admin/server-ip all 200. Frontend: user +2348099887711 login, /marketplace shows 5 product cards with images loaded via the new /api/products/{id}/image stream (naturalWidth>0, zero broken). Filter tabs All/Newcomer/Epic/Hot clickable. /investments shows product thumbnail via same stream. Admin /admin/products correctly uses ?full=true (5 imgs with data: URIs displayed) and Edit modal renders the base64 thumbnail.
critical_code_review_comments: outbound_ip_fast() is O(1) via HTTPS_PROXY parse + module-level cache — good replacement for ipify (was 3s timeout). All 5 error-return sites in create_deposit correctly switched over.

list_products rewrites image_url only when it startswith('data:'), keeping external URLs pass-through — correct. Cache-buster uses last 8 chars of base64 payload — collision-safe enough since browser can also honor Cache-Control immutable.
PUT /admin/products guard drops image_url if it starts with '/api/products/' and contains '/image' — precise pattern; verified base64 preserved through PUT.
product_image endpoint does not require auth (by design, so works); external URLs correctly 302-redirected. 404 branch and 500 on decode failure both handled.
Cloudflare in preview rewrites Cache-Control to 'no-store' — expected; service-worker v4 cache-first workaround provides browser-side caching. Not a code issue.
Investments enrichment batch-loads products by id in a single find({_id: {$in: [...]}}) — O(1) round-trip. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. The admin PUT test round-trips the existing product's fields (name/price/tier/etc.) and re-verifies the base64 is intact after PUT. No product data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf fixes verified. Products endpoint payload = ~1.4 KB (5 products) with rewritten image URLs. Deposit gateway-error paths measured at ~1.1s with outbound_ip=46.20.101.18. Frontend loads images via /api/products/{id}/image (public, no auth). Admin edit modal uses ?full=true to keep base64 thumbnails. Note: 401 errors in browser console before login (on /api/auth/me during login page) are expected and unrelated.
rca of the issue: N/A — the two reported perf bugs are resolved: (1) base64 image URIs are no longer inlined into /api/products or /api/investments JSON, saving ~640KB and ~130KB respectively. (2) The 3-second ipify.org round-trip in the deposit failure path is replaced with a synchronous HTTPS_PROXY parse (outbound_ip_fast) returning 46.20.101.18 immediately.
